Written February 7, 2026
Avanti
Dear Valued Customer,

Thank you for your feedback. We are sorry to hear that your recent experience did not meet your expectations.
We would like to clarify that our policy requiring cigars to be purchased and consumed on-site is applied in accordance with strict regulations governing authentic cigar distribution and quality control. Premium cigars are highly sensitive products, and their quality can be significantly affected by storage conditions such as humidity, temperature, and handling prior to use.
To ensure that all customers enjoy cigars in optimal condition and to maintain the standards set by official distributors, only cigars stored and sold directly at our premises are permitted for smoking in the lounge. This also allows us to guarantee product authenticity and compliance with applicable regulations.
We understand that this policy may not have been clearly communicated, and we sincerely apologize for any inconvenience or confusion caused. Your feedback is valuable and helps us improve how we inform and serve our customers.
We hope to have the opportunity to provide you with a better experience in the future.

Sincerely,
Habanos Spicialist Vietnam

Cigar lounge in Ho Chi Minh, Vietnam
Mar 2024 • Friends
Came here back to back days recently because we enjoyed this place a lot! Inside decor is nice and has a fancy feel. The “lounge floor” is strictly for cigar smoking only—a bit disappointing if you only vape, they don’t allow that. The top floor which is the “restaurant floor”, is where you can smoke whatever you please there, and offers food! While the lounge is more of a classy feel, I liked the restaurant better with their glass windows with nice chandelier and greenery decor—they also have live music at night! Their ventilation system is pretty great too (both floors).

Drinks were good, lots of bourbon/whiskey to choose from, and select vodka/gin options. The Ultimate Caviar & Salmon dish was AMAZING!!! Cigar wise, they sell Cubans, so this place is great for cigar lovers!
Read more
Written March 25, 2024
Avanti
Thank you so much for taking the time to share your detailed experience! We're thrilled to hear you enjoyed both visits and appreciated the unique atmosphere of each floor. We're glad the décor, live music, ventilation, and especially the Ultimate Caviar & Salmon dish stood out to you! We truly appreciate your feedback regarding vaping, and we’ll take it into consideration.

It means a lot to us that you enjoyed our drink selection and Cuban cigars — we look forward to welcoming you back for more great moments, whether it's a classy lounge smoke or a relaxed meal upstairs!
